req.title: Set cookie via query string
req.statement: The system shall set cookies for every k=v pair supplied in the query string of GET /cookies/set.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /cookies/set sets cookies for every k=v pair in the query string and redirects to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive - single k=v pair sets cookie correctly with exact redirect and cookie value; (2) positive multi - multiple k=v pairs all set; (3) negative - no query params yields redirect with empty cookies; (4) boundary - empty string value for a cookie key; (5) state transition - cookie appears in subsequent /cookies response. Assertions use exact values to kill mutations on key comparisons, cookie name/value assignments, and redirect targets.

tests.name: test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No pre-existing cookies in test client
trace: R-HTTPBIN-031: system shall set cookies for every k=v pair in query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=bar', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'foo=bar' in set_cookie

test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_set_multiple_cookies_via_query_string():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?alpha=1&beta=2', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['alpha'] == '1'
    assert data['cookies']['beta'] == '2'
    assert len([k for k in data['cookies'] if k in ('alpha', 'beta')]) == 2

test_set_multiple_cookies_via_query_string()

from httpbin.core import app

def test_set_cookie_redirect_target_is_exactly_cookies():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?x=y', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.status_code != 301
    assert r.status_code != 303
    assert r.status_code != 200
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'
    assert location != '/cookies/set'
    assert location != '/'

tests.name: test_set_cookie_state_transition_cookie_visible_after_redirect
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client maintains cookie jar across requests
actions: Then GET /cookies directly and assert same cookie is present
trace: R-HTTPBIN-031: cookie set by /cookies/set must persist and be visible at /cookies
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_set_cookie_state_transition_cookie_visible_after_redirect():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?session=abc123', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert data['cookies']['session'] == 'abc123'
    r2 = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    data2 = json.loads(r2.data)
    assert data2['cookies']['session'] == 'abc123'

test_set_cookie_state_transition_cookie_visible_after_redirect()

from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_set_cookie_exact_name_and_value_not_swapped():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?myname=myvalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
